annotation.title_clean: The possible uses of IEEE's First Global Ontological Standard for Ethically Driven Robotics and Automation Systems as a building block for confidence building measures regarding the responsible development and use of Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.title_en: The possible uses of IEEE's First Global Ontological Standard for Ethically Driven Robotics and Automation Systems as a building block for confidence building measures regarding the responsible development and use of Autonomous Weapons Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Brazil (submitted to the CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS)
annotation.venue: UN CCW Group of Governmental Experts on LAWS (CCW/GGE.1/2024/WP.1)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian working paper to the CCW GGE on LAWS proposing that IEEE Std 7007-2021, an ontological standard for ethically driven robotics and automation, serve as a building block for voluntary confidence-building measures on autonomous weapons systems, supporting compliance assessment, transparency and accountability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes IEEE Std 7007-2021 as a technical basis for confidence-building measures on AWS.
Standard formalizes norms, ethical principles, transparency, accountability, privacy and ethical violation management.
Could help operationalize 2023 GGE conclusions on controls and limits on targets, duration, geography and scale.
Standard can protect confidentiality and industrial IP while enabling compliance monitoring.
Brazil will advocate including the standard in CCW discussions.
